RESULT 06/08/26

✅ Implementation: Global Connection Error Handling

Summary

Connection failure handling was moved to src/Application/Handlers/HttpErrorHandler.php. This provides one shared behavior for every endpoint and removes duplicate handling from manual login.

Changes

Global error handler

HttpErrorHandler now identifies GuzzleHttp\Exception\ConnectException and:

  1. Logs the original exception with the message Upstream service connection failed.
  2. Overrides the HTTP status with 503.
  3. Uses ActionError::SERVER_ERROR to preserve the existing error response structure.
  4. Returns Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later. to the client.
  5. Prevents displayErrorDetails from replacing the safe message with the exception message.

Manual login

The connection-specific try/catch was removed from AuthLoginAction. Exceptions now propagate to the global handler, matching all other endpoints.

Regression test

tests/Application/Handlers/HttpErrorHandlerTest.php simulates a connection error containing an internal IP and port. It verifies:

  • HTTP status is 503.
  • Error status is SERVER_ERROR.
  • valid is false.
  • The public message is sanitized.
  • IP, port, and cURL details are absent.
  • The original exception is logged once.

Verification

  • git diff --check passes.
  • PHPUnit could not run in the current environment because neither PHP nor Docker is available.
  • No Git commit was created.

Objective

Prevent upstream database connection details, including IP addresses, ports, URLs, and cURL diagnostics, from being exposed in API responses.

Scope

Apply the behavior globally through HttpErrorHandler, including these affected endpoints:

  • Manual login
  • GET /additional/latest-version
  • GET /room?v=1
  • POST /users/forgot-password
  • POST /users/register
  • POST /contact-us

Requirements

  • Detect GuzzleHttp\Exception\ConnectException globally.
  • Return HTTP status 503 Service Unavailable.
  • Preserve the existing API error structure.
  • Return this public message: Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
  • Never expose connection IP, port, URL, or cURL details to clients.
  • Log the original exception server-side for diagnostics.
  • Remove endpoint-specific connection handling from manual login.
  • Add a regression test for the sanitized response.
  • Do not commit the changes.

Expected Response

{
  "statusCode": 503,
  "data": {
    "status": "SERVER_ERROR",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "messages": "Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later."
    }
  }
}

Acceptance Criteria

  • All listed endpoints use the global handler when their upstream connection fails.
  • Response status is 503.
  • Response follows the expected structure.
  • Response contains no upstream IP, port, URL, or cURL text.
  • Original exception is available in server logs.
  • Existing non-connection error behavior remains unchanged.
